## Loop contract checklist

- [ ] Trigger is specific.
- [ ] Action is bounded.
- [ ] Proof is externally checkable.
- [ ] Stopping condition is explicit.
- [ ] Risk level and approval gate are explicit.
- [ ] Cost guard exists.
- [ ] Failure modes are listed.
- [ ] Example receipt or receipt template exists.

## Safety

- [ ] No secrets, tokens, private logs, or customer data are included.
- [ ] No deploy/restart/billing/credential/external-message action is implied without approval.
